title: RECOMMENDATION message (MTap to MBin, v1, draft)
description: An entry candidate from MTap. MTap owns the signal: what, why, how likely and for how long. MBin owns the money: budget, size, rank, approval and execution. Stream mtap:evt:RECOMMENDATION, durable. See mtap-mbin-protocol.md section 8.1.

type.description: Message type; equals the stream suffix.

schema_version.description: Version of this type's schema (protocol section 6).

producer.description: MTap component that published it, e.g. mtap/recommender.

correlation_id.description: request_id of the RESYNC_REQUEST this re-publish answers; otherwise absent or null.

_key.description: rec:<rec_id>. The same value on every re-publish of this decision.

_ts.description: Epoch milliseconds, set by the publishing Bus.

rec_id.description: Unique per decision, forever. A changed decision (new data, new score) is a new rec_id.

data_ts_utc.description: Time of the market data the decision used. The TTL counts from here.

name.description: Company or fund name, for display.

action.description: BUY opens a position. MBin honours SELL only as an exit for a held symbol (protocol section 8.1).

score.description: Calibrated probability that +target_pct is touched before -stop_pct, from price_ref over probability.horizon (to the close when probability is null); the TTL is only the entry window. Against the TRADING_PARAMETERS defaults when target_pct or stop_pct is absent. The same definition for every MTap strategy, so scores compare. MBin ranks by score, then probability.value.

probability.description: Forecast of reaching probability.target_pct within probability.horizon. Null or absent when MTap has no forecast.

target_pct.description: Take-profit distance above the fill price, in percent (MTap computes it at price_ref). Null or absent: MBin applies TRADING_PARAMETERS thresholds.default_target_pct.

stop_pct.description: Protective-stop distance below the fill price, in percent. Null or absent: MBin applies thresholds.default_stop_pct.

ttl_ms.description: Validity from data_ts_utc. Null or absent: MBin uses ttl.default_ms. MBin clamps it to ttl.max_ms and to the session close.

price_ref.description: The price the decision saw. MBin sizes from it and the Console shows it.

cap_band.description: Band of market_cap: mega >= $200B, large $10-200B, mid $2-10B, small $250M-2B, micro < $250M (protocol section 8.1).

market_cap.description: Dollars, as of the previous session's close: shares outstanding (Massive ticker overview) x the previous close. MTap computes it.

rationale.description: One line shown to the operator.

inputs.description: Free-form features behind the decision, for audit and learning. MBin stores it and never interprets it. Keep it under 4 KB.

horizon.description: <n>m minutes from data_ts_utc, close (today's close) or next_session.
